app.name: Web picture
app.summary: A tile that shows the picture at an http(s) address, refreshed every few minutes if you like.
app.url_hint: The picture's address, starting with https:// or http://. Its host must be one the plugin names.
app.url_more_hint: For an address over 64 characters: the rest of it, put right after the first part.
app.refresh_hint: Fetch the picture again on this rhythm, for a picture that changes at the same address.
app.fit_hint: Cover fills the tile and cuts away what is over; contain shows the whole picture.
app.caption: Name over the picture
app.caption_hint: The tile's name in the corner of the picture.
